title: Subscription to the International Development Association
what_it_is: Subscription to the International Development Association

sections.label: IDA financing purpose
sections.summary: IDA financing promotes economic and social development, poverty reduction for eligible countries, and support for global challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: IDA financing promotes economic and social development and poverty reduction for eligible countries, as well as support for tackling pressing global challenges.

sections.label: IDA21 replenishment period and backdrop
sections.summary: IDA21 covers July 2025 to June 2028 amid a difficult global environment with extreme weather and health emergencies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The 21st IDA Replenishment (IDA21), which covers the period from July 2025 to June 2028, occurs against the backdrop of a difficult global environment, compounded by increasingly frequent extreme weather events and health emergencies.

sections.label: IDA21 poverty, food insecurity, funding
sections.summary: COVID-19 erased three years of poverty progress; 651 million faced food insecurity in 2023; donors agreed to US$100 billion IDA21.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: According to the World Bank Group, the COVID-19 pandemic erased three years of progress in reducing the extreme poverty rate in IDA countries.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: About 651 million people in IDA countries faced food insecurity in 2023, nearly double the number in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In December 2024, IDA donors agreed to expand the IDA21 replenishment envelope to US$100 billion – a historical high.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Specifically, 45% of the IDA21 commitments will be channelled towards climate mitigation and adaptation efforts.

sections.label: Singapore IDA21 subscription proposal
sections.summary: Singapore proposes subscribing no more than US$87 million to IDA21, a 24% increase from IDA20.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For this Motion, we are proposing that Singapore make a subscription of no more than US$87 million to IDA for the purpose of IDA21.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This represents about a 24% increase in absolute terms from our IDA20 subscription; or a corresponding 10% increase in our burden share.
